title: Does the job, but is different!
text:
Does the job, but is different!. Nice kitchenAid food processor.
Heavy base, lighter weight plastic top.
This is not a large processor. If your a baker , have a large family, or entertain allot, you might not find this large enough,or
You will have to empty it a couple of times while using it!

It’s pretty basic, ,Low, High, Off/Pulse. I like basic. Both blades are sharp enough for me.
This proccesor is different then other ones I have used, and those all worked in the same way.
This KitchenAid,to use the Shreder / grader you have to Put the middle part in to have the grader sit high enough up, or lower, not sure why you would want it lower!
The Lid goes up and down, fits into a plastic slot / hinge, which is something I have to get use too! Then you lock the top down on the other side before using this that has a cheesy chrome looking lock..Another added feature I have to get use too!

I peeled yams, and put them in the tube to slice them. I noticed if I did not push hard enough in the tube, they came out
Very thinly sliced. When I pushed harder they came out thicker..Btw this is not my first time using a processor.

The tube is not straight down, its a bit at a angle, and so is the pusher. You have to make sure you have the pusher at the right side to use it, or
Use the other side of it.

That said , this will take a little getting use to, but it will do the job it’s intended for..
The price is reasonable, but not sure how long this will last for!!

I personsonally do not know why KichenAid felt they had to redesign a food processor, when there was nothing wrong with
It to begin with! Or just to get new buyers !

product_metadata.title: KitchenAid 13-Cup Food Processor, Onyx Black
features: All-in-one storage solution to store all blades and discs directly in the in-bowl storage caddy.
Easily adjust slicing thickness with the externally adjustable Exact Slice disc, from thick to thin.

Snap and Go, easy clean work bowl for easy set up with the twist-free, one-click bowl assembly and latched lid. Add warm water and 1-2 drops of dish soap in the leak-resistant bowl to quickly clean bowl and blades.
Reduce prep time with the 3-in-1 Feed Tube to process a variety of ingredient shapes and sizes - tomatoes, cucumbers, potatoes and more.
Chop, shred, precision slice, knead and mix everything from fresh veggies to cheeses, doughs, sauces, salsa and so much more.
The right capacity for every occasion - whether it’s a quick and fresh salsa for Taco Tuesday or major slicing event for pizza on Friday night, the 13 cup capacity has you covered.
Model KFP1318 includes (1) food processor, (1) 13-cup work bowl, (1) multi-purpose blade, (1) adjustable slicing disc, (1) reversible shredding disc, (1) dough blade, (1) storage caddy
description: Easily tackle tough chopping, shredding and kneading tasks with a powerful motor and durable blades. This 13-Cup Food Processor is the right capacity for every meal-making occasion, big or small. And, it’s easier than ever to elevate all of your everyday meals with all of the functions it has to offer. Chop, shred, precision slice, knead, mix and puree everything from fresh veggies to cheeses, doughs, sauces, salsa and so much more. The 3-in-1 feed tube reduces prep time, allowing you to process a variety of ingredient shapes and sizes - tomatoes, cucumbers, potatoes and more. In addition to being easy to use, all of the accessories fit nice and neat in the included storage caddy, which nestles directly inside the 13 cup bowl.
